title: Kissed Moroccan Wensleydale Tagine
description: A rich, flaky tagine combining creamy Wensleydale cheese, aromatic spices, and sweet apricots, finished with a smoky char from binchotan charcoal for a date-night Moroccan experience.
instructions: Heat the tagine over medium heat and add olive oil, then sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the carrot and zucchini and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chickpeas, tomato sauce, orange juice, orange zest, dried thyme, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Fold in the chopped apricots and preserved lemon slices, cover and cook for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Reduce the heat to low and add the Wensleydale cheese, stirring gently until the cheese melts into the sauce.
Meanwhile, heat a small pan over the binchotan charcoal and sear the remaining Wensleydale cheese until it develops a smoky crust.
Place the seared cheese slice on top of the melted cheese in the tagine and return to the heat for 5 minutes to marry the flavors.
Sprinkle toasted almonds over the tagine and allow everything to heat through for an additional minute.
Remove from heat, garnish with fresh herbs if desired, and serve warm to your date tonight.
Enjoy the smoky, creamy Moroccan tagine that showcases the unique fusion of Wensleydale cheese and traditional spices.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
